name: Dot & Key Blueberry Hydrate Barrier Repair Sunscreen 80gm SPF50+ PA++++ | For Dry & Sensitive Skin | Non - Greasy Finish | No White Cast | UV & Blue Light Protection | Broad Spectrum
description:
Dot & Key Blueberry Hydrate Barrier Repair Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++ | 80g | For Dry & Sensitive Skin

Protect and nourish your skin with Dot & Key Blueberry Hydrate Barrier Repair Sunscreen, specially designed for dry and sensitive skin. This lightweight, non-greasy sunscreen offers broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA++++ protection against harmful UVA, UVB, and blue light rays while deeply moisturizing and repairing the skin barrier.

Key Features:

High Protection: Infused with 6 UV filters for maximum UV & blue light defense

Barrier Repair: Enriched with 5 ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and blueberry extract to strengthen and restore the skin barrier

Long-Lasting Hydration: Provides lasting moisturization for soft, supple skin

No White Cast: Lightweight, quick-absorbing cream with a non-greasy finish

Water Resistant: Effective for up to 80 minutes of water exposure

Skin Type: Ideal for dry and sensitive skin

Net Weight: 80g
